name: Nha Trang resort living
summary: Tran Phu city sand, Hon Tre island resorts, and Ninh Van Bay villas across the water.
body: The municipal beach is hotel row on Tran Phu. Hon Tre is a cable-car island with Vinpearl’s resort cluster. Ninh Van Bay is a boat transfer from town.
Names come from operator sites. Island resorts budget extra time for the boat or car from Cam Ranh airport.

properties.name: Vinpearl Resort Nha Trang
properties.summary: Hon Tre island resort with private beaches and the VinWonders park.

properties.name: Six Senses Ninh Van Bay
properties.summary: Water-access villas in Ninh Van Bay, reached by boat from Nha Trang.
